lines: Mallika R Iyer, Promoter Group, holds 1,234,500 shares, valued at ₹166.90 crore (estimate, valued at offer price).
Shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, so the trigger is recent; the shares are not cash.
Timing is pre-Offer capital, unlocked since 9 Sep 2026; they are not selling in the offer.
Confidence is medium: proceeds and gain are not in the seller table, and holdings agree across two sections.
